section1.heading: I'm Lawrence Ughonu
section1.subtitle: React Native & Full-Stack Engineer
section1.description: Building intelligent mobile and web applications with AI integration
section1.text: I transform complex ideas into elegant, scalable solutions. With expertise in React Native, TypeScript, and Python, I create apps that millions of users love.

recent_posts.title: Building Cross-Platform Mobile Apps with React Native
recent_posts.text: React Native enables developers to build truly native mobile applications for iOS and Android from a single codebase. With TypeScript integration, Expo for rapid development, and native modules for C++ integration, React Native is the go-to framework for building modern mobile applications with excellent performance.

recent_posts.title: Integrating AI Voice Features into Mobile Apps
recent_posts.text: AI voice features are revolutionizing mobile app interactions. By integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and conversational AI, we can create accessible and engaging user experiences. Combining OpenAI APIs with React Native creates powerful voice-enabled applications.

featured_works.title: SQE App
featured_works.text: Built a comprehensive mobile application with multiple modules including blockchain wallet, real-time messaging (WebSocket), organization management, contacts, digital asset management, QR code scanning, and integrated AI features. Developed using React Native, TypeScript, C++ native modules, and native performance optimizations.

featured_works.title: Paka User App - NYXIDIOM
featured_works.text: Developed a production-ready React Native mobile application for logistics/delivery service as part of NYXIDIOM's React expert team. Built with Expo framework and TypeScript, implementing complete authentication flows with Supabase, Stripe payment processing, real-time push notifications, and Google Maps integration. Successfully fixed critical iOS memory management issues and optimized keyboard handling, demonstrating strong problem-solving skills in cross-platform development.

featured_works.title: Invoice Validator System - NYXIDIOM
featured_works.topic: Python • FastAPI • AWS Lambda • Document Intelligence
featured_works.text: Created an intelligent document processing system for logistics invoice validation as part of NYXIDIOM's backend solutions. Supports multiple companies (MRW, Schenker, Sertrans, TXT) with automated PDF and Excel processing using Python and FastAPI. Deployed on AWS Lambda with batch processing capabilities and achieved 48% validation accuracy. Demonstrates expertise in document intelligence, API development, and cloud infrastructure.

featured_works.title: Swiftbranding
featured_works.text: Managed website development project from initial design through completion, optimizing all cross-browser and multi-platform compatibility using React library. Implemented complex routing with React Router including URL Parameters, Nested Routes, and Code Splitting.

featured_works.title: Digifigs
featured_works.text: Refactored and updated Digifigs company website using React library and styled-components for styling. Worked with carefully selected fonts, color palette, and other assets to create an awesome user-interface with responsive design and excellent user experience.
